title: 19. Nintendo: The Switch 2 Edition w/ Ryan O'Connor (Crossroads Capital)

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to another episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to another episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast. This week I was lucky enough to be joined for the second time by Ryan O'Connor, founder and CEO of Crossroads Capital. Crossroads Capital holds a significant position in Nintendo, and as Nintendo recently hosted the Switch 2 Direct.

thesis: The episode argues that Nintendo is an extraordinary bargain with a valuation as attractive as it has been since 2018, driven by the upcoming Switch 2 launch which is expected to sell significantly above Wall Street consensus. The speaker believes the company has the flexibility to grow membership and profits exponentially over the next three to four years through live service games and NSO, while maintaining strong brand loyalty and resilience even during recessions or macro uncertainty.
